Players Committee card image of [[Rogue One (ALT)]] (original printing), game text: “May add 2 pilots and 4 passengers. May deploy with a pilot to a system without presence or Force icons. Spies deploy -1 aboard. Immune to attrition < 6 at opponent system (unless a Dark Jedi here).”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/rogueone_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/793bf6567aab6b7f98de47650aedffa0d0097f93 793bf65] (15 January 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
